title: Higher-order variation and pathwise Ito calculus on manifolds
summary: We develop an intrinsic calculus for smooth functions of paths of arbitrarily low regularity on smooth manifolds. The regularity of paths is defined in terms of a $p$-th variation tensor along a sequence of partitions, for an arbitrary integer $p$; this tensor is constructed as a local symmetric tensor measure along the path. We define pathwise integrals of closed one-forms along paths with finite $p$-th variation and derive a change of variable formula for smooth functions of such paths.
